results.title: Detecting Revenue Leakage in Usage-Based Pricing
results.author: Synthetic Research Collective
results.text: Usage-based pricing introduces many rate dimensions, credits, and commitments. Under-monetized usage and metering gaps are among the most common sources of revenue leakage in hybrid pricing models.
highlights: Under-monetized usage and metering gaps are among the most common sources of revenue leakage.

results.title: A Failed-Payment Recovery Playbook
results.author: Synthetic Billing Guild
results.text: A structured dunning sequence with timed recovery prompts recovers a meaningful share of failed charges before the accounts churn.
highlights: A structured dunning sequence recovers a meaningful share of failed charges before churn.

results.title: Margin Compression and Commitment Drawdown
results.text: Frequent pricing changes and unused commitments can quietly compress margins when credits are applied inconsistently across accounts.

results.title: Approval-Gated Billing Actions
results.text: Irreversible billing actions should sit behind an explicit human approval gate backed by an append-only audit trail.
